name: Relative Depth Loss
definition: A loss function that uses MVS depth priors to regularize geometry by comparing MVS depth against rendered depth, using thresholding to reject erroneous MVS values and weighting by rendering certainty.
summary: Relative Depth Loss is a regularization term that aligns rendered median depth with MVS priors using a relative formulation, distinguishing itself by rejecting erroneous values via thresholding and weighting by rendering certainty.
